name: NotPetya
blurb: Draft exercise based on the documented incident “NotPetya” (CTID Attack Flow corpus). Analysis of 2017 malware outbreak.

injects.title: Search Open Websites/Domains
injects.text: Attackers conducted reconnaissance by learning about EDRPOU and M.E.Doc, queried EDRPOU website, and changed their computer language sets to the… Attackers added malicious functionality to the files containing software updates for M.E.Doc to collect a list of all EDRPOUs associated with… NotPetya drops the ransomware DLL perfc.dat, writes a resource to C:\Windows\dllhost.dat, and drops its ransomware splash and warning files.

injects.title: Security Software Discovery
injects.text: Malware starts subroutine and hashes every running process on the system and sets PROC_FLAG. It is looking for three hardcoded hashes: Kaspersky,… Malware attempts to determine privilege of its running process and sets the PRIV_FLAG: SeTcbPrivilege, SeDebugPrivilege, SeShutdownPrivilege. Operates as a modified version of Mimikatz and uses a named pipe to extract credentials from LSASS.

decision.prompt: Responders see this activity (Security Software Discovery). What do they do?

injects.title: Token Impersonation/Theft
injects.text: Duplicates another user's token and allows attacker to escalate privileges and impersonate another user to spread the malware. To move laterally, NotPetya tests for vulnerable SMBv1 condition (Eternal Blue/Romance exploit) and deploys an SMB backdoor. NotPetya will not encrypt the MFT and will simply overwrite the first 10 sectors of the physical disk with uninitialized data. It will still render…

injects.title: Bootkit
injects.text: Malware reads and encodes MBR with a custom boot loader that will encrypt the MFT. To move laterally, the malware logs into any version of SMB with the stolen tokens or harvested credentials and does a UNC write to Admin$ to execute. Malware issues commands to gather list of known IP addresses and TCP endpoints and enumerate domain controllers.

injects.title: Dynamic-link Library Injection
injects.text: To deploy NotPetya on the system, a staging DLL is injected into lsass.exe. NotPetya creates a scheduled task that triggers a reboot 60 min after execution by default. Malware executes either using PsExec or WMIC as rundll32.exe.

injects.title: System Shutdown/Reboot
injects.text: System reboots, displays decoy message. The custom boot loader encrypts the MFT. NotPetya also encrypted files with specific extensions. The malware clears setup, system, security, application, and USN journal logs.
